eyebrow.zh: 到顶即停 · 请求不出本机 · 不挂后台 · 不回传数据
eyebrow.en: Stops at the cap · Stays on your machine · No background process · Phones nothing home

headline.zh:
给编码 Agent 设一道硬上限
到顶就停，下一条请求不出本机
headline.en:
A hard cap on what your coding agent can spend
— it stops at the line, before the next request leaves

sub.zh: 在项目根目录放一个 .fuse.toml，写上这项目最多花几美元——或每天最多花多少。你的 claude、codex、aider 跑过夜循环时，累计花费一到上限就停，下一条请求直接在本机被挡回。想把它指向你自己的上游网关也行，上限照常守住。不挂后台、不上云、不回传任何数据。一个会偷偷回传数据的熔断器，本身就是问题。
sub.en: Drop a .fuse.toml at your project root with a USD cap — per project, or per day. When your claude, codex, or aider runs an overnight loop, the moment cumulative spend hits the cap it stops — the next request is turned back at your machine. Point it at your own upstream gateway if you like; the cap still holds. No background process, no cloud, nothing phoned home. A kill-switch that phones home is itself the problem.

title.zh: 到顶就停，并发也冲不过上限
title.en: Stops at the cap — even under concurrent load

body.zh: 一个过夜循环里，几十条请求可能同时往外冲。agentfuse 在每条请求出门前都核对一次累计花费——到顶就挡回，不管同时有多少条在飞。被挡回的那条会告诉你为什么、该怎么办，不再是一句空话。想要按天设上限？到你的本地午夜自动清零，不是 UTC 零点。没有“差一点没卡住”这种事。
body.en: In an overnight loop, dozens of requests can race out at once. agentfuse checks the running total before each one leaves — and turns back any that would cross the line, no matter how many are in flight. The denied request tells you why and what to do — not a blank line. Want a per-day cap? It auto-resets at YOUR local midnight, not UTC midnight. There's no 'almost held' here.

chips: › 挡回的那条会告诉你为什么
› 按天上限到本地午夜清零

title.zh: 不管你用哪家的模型、指向哪个上游，上限都一样
title.en: Same cap, whichever model — and whichever upstream you point it at

body.zh: 一份 .fuse.toml、一行 fuse run，管住你接的每一家模型服务，也管住你把它指向的任何自定义上游——你的网关、你的区域端点。流式回复漏报花费时，agentfuse 在本地把花费补回来，绝不悄悄记一笔 $0。流式回复的每一种形状现在都照算：再没有一种流式能让花费悄悄绕过上限。一个挂起的上游也不会把你的额度占住不放——几分钟内自动退还，上限不被一条卡住的请求拖垮。
body.en: One .fuse.toml, one fuse run — the cap holds across every model service you've configured, and across any custom upstream you point it at: your gateway, your regional endpoint. When a streamed reply omits its usage, agentfuse reconstructs the cost locally — it never silently bills $0. Every shape of streamed reply is now counted: no streamed shape can quietly slip past the cap. And a stalled upstream won't hold your budget hostage — the reservation releases within minutes, so one hung request can't drag the cap down.

chips: › 一份配置管所有模型服务
› 漏报花费本地补回，绝不记 $0
› 流式回复每一种形状都照算

title.zh: 价格表在你本机，从不联网
title.en: Prices live on your machine, never fetched

body.zh: 模型价格内置在工具里，你可以按机器覆盖。agentfuse 从不联网取价——这是它能当熔断器的前提。fuse prices --diff 还会告诉你：你的本地覆盖里，哪些压住了已变动的默认值，哪些指向已经下架的模型。
body.en: Model prices ship inside the tool; you override them per machine. agentfuse never fetches a price over the network — that's the premise for a tool allowed to cut off your spend. fuse prices --diff shows which of your overrides shadow a default that has since moved, and which point at a model that has since been retired.

title.zh: 全部留在本机，三十秒能审完
title.en: Everything stays local — auditable in 30 seconds

body.zh: 花费只写在你本机的一个文件里，工具随你那条 Agent 命令一起退出，不挂后台。除了你配的那家模型服务，它不和任何东西通信。三十秒就能审完它会不会回传数据——一个会偷偷回传的熔断器，本身就是信任问题。
body.en: Spend is written to a single file on your machine; the tool exits with the agent command it wrapped — nothing lingers in the background. It talks to nothing but the model service you configured. You can audit in thirty seconds whether it phones anything home — a kill-switch that phones home is itself the trust problem.

headline.zh: 一行 .fuse.toml，守住每个项目的上限

sub.zh: 开源、Apache-2.0、无付费墙。在你本机给 Agent 设上限这件事，永不收费。
sub.en: Open source, Apache-2.0, no paywall. The act of capping your agent locally is never gated.

tag.zh: 给编码 Agent 花费装的本地熔断器
tag.en: The local kill-switch for coding-agent spend

changelog.zh: 按侧 tiktoken 兜底现在也作用于 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 处理器，部分用量流不再会少计输出侧而让花费突破预算上限。托管账户密钥现在也会注入到 Gemini provider。
changelog.en: The per-side tiktoken fallback now applies to the Anthropic and OpenAI handlers too, so a partial-usage stream can no longer under-bill the output side and let spend exceed the cap. The managed account key is now injected for the Gemini provider.
